levels.leanTip: Minimal independence: the capital covers leaner spending — 70 % of the current one. For those ready to live more frugally.
levels.regularTip: Classic FIRE: the capital you can withdraw the chosen rate from every year (usually 4 %) to cover your current spending without eating it up.
levels.fatTip: Independence with a margin: capital for spending 1.5 times the current one — for a more comfortable life and the unexpected.
levels.coastTip: What is enough to have already: even without new contributions it grows into FIRE in 20 years on returns alone. From then on you only need to earn your current spending.
